Pipeline und Partnerschaften aufbauen. Zielgruppe: Unternehmen im DACH-Raum mit vielen Erstgesprächen und spürbarer Fluktuation. Ansprechpartner: CHROs und Heads of Talent Acquisition, dazu ATS-Anbieter und Beratungen.

Aus den Pilotpartnern zahlende Kunden machen, inklusive Onboarding.

Preise, Pakete, Verträge und die großen Fragen: Rechtsform, Beteiligung, Steuern, Finanzierung. Die entscheiden wir zu zweit.

Du hast B2B-Abschlüsse selbst getragen, von der ersten Mail bis zur Unterschrift. Wie viele Berufsjahre dahinterstehen, zähle ich nicht mit. Erzähl mir lieber von einem dieser Abschlüsse.

title: Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (SiFA) (w/m/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (SiFa) übernimmst Du die eigenständige Betreuung eines Unternehmens im Bereich Arbeitssicherheit und berätst Geschäftsführung sowie Führungskräfte zu allen relevanten EHS-Themen. Dabei entwickelst Du Prozesse weiter, begleitest operative Themen und stellst eine rechtskonforme Arbeitsschutzorganisation sicher.

  • Eigenständige Betreuung eines Unternehmens als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit gemäß ASiG und DGUV Vorschrift 2

  • Beratung und Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung sowie Führungskräften in allen Fragen des Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzes

  • Durchführung und Begleitung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, Begehungen und Unfalluntersuchungen

  • Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen sowie konsequente Nachverfolgung bis zur Umsetzung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Aufsichtsstellen und Berufsgenossenschaften

title: People Ops Partner - Working Student (f/m/x)
description:
HEY THERE!
We are Mercedes-Benz.io. Our mission is to ignite and build digital solutions for Mercedes-Benz by bringing together a tribe of digital enthusiasts who drive the digital future of mobility.

We believe flexibility and collaboration go hand in hand. With an office in Stuttgart, we offer a flexible hybrid setup with an average of one day per week in the office, while also supporting remote work with occasional visits to the office.

This allows for meaningful in-person collaboration while maintaining the flexibility to work in a way that best supports you and your team.

We do not care about your shoes, as long as you bring the right attitude. At Mercedes-Benz.io we walk the talk and make things happen. We do not digitise for the sake of being digital, but to create real value. We reflect, challenge the status quo, and stand up for each other. This is why we hire people who want to make an impact.

PEOPLE OPERATIONS AT MB.io 

At Mercedes-Benz.io, People Operations is at the heart of creating a seamless employee experience. We ensure that our HR processes run smoothly, support employees throughout their journey, and continuously improve the way we work through digitalization, automation, and data-driven decision-making. 

Over the coming years, our team will play a key role in major transformation initiatives, including the automation of administrative HR tasks, the introduction of AI-driven processes, the implementation of new HR tools, and the improvement of manual payroll workflows. As a Working Student, you will contribute to both our daily operations and these exciting change initiatives.

Role Description
As an AI Engineer (Computer Vision Focus), you will be a key driver in integrating Artificial Intelligence capabilities into both our existing product lines and new client solutions. Your primary focus will be on Computer Vision (CV), designing, developing, and deploying robust CV models for tasks such as object detection, image classification, and visual data analysis. You will also be instrumental in orchestrating complex AI workflows that combine Generative AI (GenAI) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques, ensuring seamless integration and high performance in a consulting and system integrator environment. This role requires a strong balance of theoretical knowledge and practical implementation skills.
Key Responsibilities
1.
AI Solution Development & Implementation
Computer Vision Specialization: Design, train, test, and deploy state-of-the-art Computer Vision models (e.g., YOLO, R-CNN, segmentation models) tailored for various business use cases (e.g., quality control, security, asset tracking).
AI Workflow Orchestration: Develop and maintain end-to-end AI pipelines, integrating CV models with GenAI models (LLMs/VLMs) and RAG frameworks to create sophisticated, context-aware applications.
Model Deployment: Work closely with MLOps/DevOps teams to ensure models are deployed efficiently, scalable, and maintainable in cloud and on-premise environments (e.g., using Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services).
2.
Research & Innovation
Feasibility Study: Conduct research into new and emerging AI/CV technologies (including specialized hardware like GPUs/TPUs for inference) to assess their potential for PT. Mitra Cakra Digital's product portfolio and client projects.
Prototyping: Build quick proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and prototypes to demonstrate the value and technical feasibility of AI/CV solutions to internal stakeholders and clients.
3.
Collaboration & Consulting
Cross-Functional Teamwork: Collaborate with Software Developers, System Architects, and Project Managers to define requirements and integrate AI solutions into larger systems.
Technical Documentation: Create clear, comprehensive documentation for models, pipelines, and APIs to facilitate knowledge transfer and future maintenance.
Qualifications
A. Core Technical Skills (Must-Have)
Programming Proficiency: Expert in Python and its data science ecosystem (Pandas, NumPy).
Computer Vision Expertise: Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of Computer Vision algorithms, techniques, and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras).
CV Libraries: Hands-on experience with popular CV libraries (e.g., OpenCV, PIL, scikit-image).
GenAI/LLMs/RAG: Basic to intermediate understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Vector Databases, and the implementation of RAG architectures.
MLOps Fundamentals: Experience with version control (Git) and familiarity with CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and model deployment frame

Job description for AI ENGINEER – GEN AI at Viettel Cyber Security

Thiết kế, triển khai các giải pháp ứng dụng AI trong các hệ thống an toàn thông tin. Xây dựng các phần mềm, hệ thống sử dụng AI nhằm tự động hóa các quá trình theo dõi, giám sát, phát hiện thâm nhập, xử lý sự cố.
Nghiên cứu và lựa chọn công nghệ cho các sản phẩm AI nội bộ phục vụ giám sát và phản ứng sự cố.

Tốt nghiệp đại học trở lên chuyên ngành CNTT, Khoa học Máy tính, Toán – Tin hoặc liên quan
Tiếng Anh tương đương 650 TOEIC trở lên

Có tối thiểu 3 năm làm việc hoặc nghiên cứu trong lĩnh vực AI/ML; ưu tiên đã có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong các dự án lớn về NLP, LLM
Thành thạo ngôn ngữ lập trình Python; Thành thạo các thư viện lập trình cho AI
Có kiến thức sâu về chắc về cấu trúc dữ liệu và giải thuật
Thành thạo các mô hình học máy, học sâu thông dụng
Có kiến thức về design pattern của Agentic AI và đã từng triển khai tối thiểu 1 dự án thực tế
Có khả năng sử dụng, tối ưu prompt và đã có kinh nghiệm phát triển ứng dụng tích hợp với các API của mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn (bao gồm function calling)
Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với dữ liệu time series, tabular, text
Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với các mô hình LLM, GenAI, agenticAI, các kỹ thuật như RAG, CoT, … là một lợi thế

Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng các nền tảng xử lý dữ liệu lớn như: Hadoop, spark, notebook là một lợi thế

Kesempatan
PT Karya Solusi Prima Sejahtera mencari Sekretaris profesional dan terorganisir yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Jakarta Selatan. Sebagai Sekretaris, Anda akan menjadi tulang punggung operasional administratif dan akan memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung kelancaran operasi perkantoran serta membantu manajemen dalam menjalankan tugas-tugas strategis. Kandidat yang ideal adalah individu yang detail-oriented, memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent, dan mampu mengelola berbagai tugas administratif secara simultan dengan efisien. Posisi ini adalah pekerjaan fulltime yang berbasis di Jakarta Selatan, memungkinkan Anda untuk berkontribusi secara langsung dalam kesuksesan tim.
Tanggung Jawab
Mengelola jadwal, pertemuan, dan janji temu untuk eksekutif atau departemen, memastikan koordinasi yang sempurna dan pengingat tepat waktu.
Menangani korespondensi, baik surat masuk maupun keluar, dengan profesionalisme dan ketelitian tinggi.
Mempersiapkan dan mengedit dokumen, laporan, dan presentasi dengan menggunakan perangkat lunak office standar.
Mengelola file dan sistem dokumentasi dengan rapi, memastikan akses mudah terhadap informasi penting.
Menyediakan dukungan administrasi umum seperti pemesanan ruang rapat, pengaturan logistik acara, dan pengelolaan persediaan kantor.
Berkomunikasi dengan klien internal dan eksternal melalui telepon, email, dan media komunikasi lainnya dengan profesional dan ramah.
Membantu dalam penyelenggaraan pertemuan termasuk penyiapan materi, pencatatan notulensi, dan follow-up tindakan lanjutan.
Melakukan tugas-tugas khusus yang diperlukan untuk mendukung kinerja manajemen.
Persyaratan
Pendidikan minimal Sekolah Menengah Atas (SMA) atau sederajat; pendidikan di bidang administrasi, sekretaris, atau terkait akan menjadi nilai tambah.
Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman sebagai Sekretaris, Asisten Administratif, atau posisi administrasi sejenis.
Kemampuan mengetik cepat dan akurat dengan kecepatan minimal 60 kata per menit.
Penguasaan yang sangat baik terhadap Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan aplikasi perkantoran lainnya.
Kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tertulis yang excellent dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris akan menjadi keuntungan.
Keterampilan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang luar biasa dengan kemampuan memprioritaskan tugas multitasking.

Kesempatan
Kami mencari seorang Inventory Planner yang berpengalaman dan detail-oriented untuk bergabung dengan tim PT Multi Cipta Mas. Sebagai Inventory Planner, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengoptimalkan manajemen inventaris dan memastikan ketersediaan produk yang efisien di seluruh operasi kami. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang perencanaan pasokan, analisis permintaan, dan pengendalian inventaris untuk mendukung kelancaran operasional perusahaan. Jabatan ini menawarkan peluang bekerja penuh waktu yang stabil dengan lokasi di Bekasi, Jawa Barat.
Tanggung Jawab
Mengelola dan memantau persediaan barang untuk memastikan ketersediaan stok dan akurasi data inventaris.
Menginput dan memperbarui data master barang serta part number baru ke dalam sistem.
Memastikan proses penerimaan dan pengeluaran barang sesuai dengan dokumen dan prosedur yang berlaku.
Melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap barang yang diterima untuk memastikan jumlah dan kondisi barang sesuai.
Memantau level stok serta mengidentifikasi potensi kekurangan atau kelebihan stok untuk mendukung kelancaran operasional.
Berkoordinasi dengan tim Purchasing, Sales, Finance, dan Gudang terkait kebutuhan dan ketersediaan stok.
Menyiapkan dan memelihara administrasi serta laporan persediaan barang secara berkala.
Melakukan stock opname secara berkala serta menindaklanjuti selisih stok yang ditemukan.
Memastikan kesesuaian antara data sistem dan kondisi fisik barang di gudang.
Mengatur penempatan barang agar tersusun rapi, mudah ditemukan, dan mudah diakses.
Mendukung kebutuhan audit internal maupun eksternal yang berkaitan dengan persediaan barang
Persyaratan
Berusia max 30 tahun
Domisili diutamakan daerah Bekasi & Jakarta Timur
Pendidikan minimal Diploma atau Sarjana (S1)
Minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Inventory Planner atau posisi serupa di industri manufaktur, atau logistik.
Pemahaman mendalam tentang prinsip-prinsip manajemen inventaris, perencanaan permintaan, dan optimalisasi rantai pasokan.
Kemampuan menggunakan software manajemen inventaris dan sistem ERP (seperti SAP, Tally, atau sistem serupa).
Keterampilan analisis data yang kuat dengan kemampuan menggunakan spreadsheet dan tools analitik untuk membuat keputusan berbasis data.
Pemahaman tentang metode peramalan permintaan (demand forecasting) dan teknik pengendalian inventaris.

About Us
We are a fast-growing e-commerce and digital marketing company operating multiple consumer brands across beauty, personal care, and lifestyle categories. We leverage technology, automation, and AI to improve business efficiency, customer experience, and decision-making.
We are looking for an AI Engineer who is passionate about building AI-powered solutions, automating workflows, and integrating modern AI technologies into real business operations.

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and automation systems.

Experience working with LLMs, AI APIs, and prompt engineering.

Experience with REST APIs, databases, and cloud services.
Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and AI deployment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and deliver practical business solutions.

Experience building AI agents and workflow automation systems.
Experience with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
Knowledge of Docker, Git, and cloud deployment.
Experience in e-commerce, marketing technology, or business automation is a plus.
What We Offer
Opportunity to work directly on real business challenges.
Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies and tools.
Fast-paced and innovation-driven work environment.
Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding company.
Competitive salary based on experience and capabilities.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

title: Senior Backend Engineer: Machine Learning Infrastructure
description:
About Us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About The Role

The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the shared backend services and platform capabilities that Constructor's ML and product teams rely on to develop, deploy, and run machine learning at scale - from model serving (including LLMs) to the specialized storages and data pipelines behind it.

We are a service team by nature: our roadmap is shaped by the needs of product teams, and we succeed when they can move faster with less friction. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is comfortable with, and motivated by this dynamic, and who will take end-to-end ownership of core services.

In the near and mid-term, our focus areas include:

  • Making ML workloads easy to run, scale, and operate for every team

  • Providing self-service, configurable infrastructure components to ML and product teams

  • Owning and evolving core ML services and related pipelines with a high bar for reliability and performance

Challenges you will tackle

  • Design, build, and operate high-load distributed backend services that power the company's ML infrastructure

  • Take end-to-end ownership of core ML services and related data pipelines: from design and implementation to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with ML and product

We focus on harnessing the power of data to inform our decision-making processes and guide our expansion. As part of our team, you'll develop sophisticated data models, enhance our internal databases, and deliver actionable insights that fuel our business strategies.

Data Collection & Analysis: Gather, synthesize, and analyze data from a variety of sources, transforming raw data into meaningful insights that directly support strategic decision-making and business development initiatives.

Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with cross-functional teams and report directly to the Head of Business Development & Market Intelligence, providing regular updates on data-driven insights and recommendations. 

Machine Learning & AI Enablement: Support the development and implementation of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions to uncover predictive insights. Leverage predictive modeling and AI-driven approaches to generate deeper market and business insights.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
Junior AI Engineer Pt Cipta Piranti Sejahtera
ACCURATE INDONESIA
is looking for a
Junior AI Engineer
to help us ship Generative AI features that real users depend on. This is a hands-on implementation role, not a research role. You will spend most of your time building AI agents, wiring them into automated workflows, and turning prototypes into services that run reliably in production.
Qualifications
0–2 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, automation, or AI/ML implementation. Strong fresh graduates with substantial hands-on Gen-AI projects are welcome to apply.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrable practical experience.
A portfolio of Gen-AI work you personally built — an agent, a RAG chatbot, an automation workflow, or an LLM-powered internal tool. GitHub repositories, deployed demos, or a walkthrough during interview all count. This matters more to us than years of experience.
Technical Skills - Must Have
Python
— solid working proficiency. You can build and structure a real application, not just run notebooks.
LangChain
— practical experience building chains, agents, tools, retrievers, and memory. You understand what the abstractions do underneath, not only how to copy examples.
n8n (or an equivalent workflow automation platform such as Make, Zapier, Dify, or Flowise)
— you have built multi-step workflows with branching, error handling, and external integrations. Direct n8n experience is a strong plus; if you come from another tool, we expect you to pick up n8n quickly.
LLM API integration
— working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar; understanding of tokens, context windows, temperature, function/tool calling, and structured output.
Prompt engineering
— system prompts, few-shot examples, output schemas, and iterating on prompts based on observed failures.
RAG fundamentals
— embeddings, chunking strategies, vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector), and similarity search.
REST APIs and JSON
— you can read API documentation, authenticate, handle pagination, and debug a failing request.
Git
— branching, pull requests, and collaborative workflow.
SQL and basic database work
— querying, joins, and reading a schema you did not design.
Ways of Working
Strong debugging instinct. When an agent gives a wrong answer, you can trace whether the problem is the prompt, the retrieval, the tool, or the data — and you do not stop at 'the model is bad'.
Comfortable with ambiguity. Gen-AI requirements are rarely fully specified; you can propose a concrete approach and validate it fast.
Ships and iterates. You would rather deliver a working v1 this week and improve it than perfect a design for a month.
Reads documentation and release notes. This field changes monthly and we expect you to keep up without being told.
Clear written communication in Bahasa Indonesia and functional

title: Onboarding Expert
description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

  • Host ~5 pre-booked 15-minute onboarding consultations daily.

  • Keep clear documentation of all interactions.

title: Fachberater/in Milchvieh
description:
Bei Claudius Wurth Agrarberatung bieten wir maßgeschneiderte Beratungslösungen für landwirtschaftliche Betriebe an, die sich auf betriebswirtschaftliche Fragen spezialisiert haben. Unser Team unterstützt Landwirte bei wichtigen Entscheidungen wie Hofübergaben, der Erstellung professioneller Gutachten und der Neuausrichtung landwirtschaftlicher Betriebe. Als Unternehmensberater/in für den Bereich Milchvieh spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, unsere Klienten bei der Optimierung ihrer Milchviehbetriebe zu unterstützen. Sie beraten zu Themen wie Direktvermarktung und neuen Stallkonzepten und tragen so zur nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung unserer Kunden bei. Bei uns erwartet Sie ein dynamisches Umfeld mit vielfältigen Herausforderungen, in dem Sie Ihre Expertise einbringen und weiterentwickeln können. Werden Sie Teil eines engagierten Teams, das landwirtschaftliche Betriebe in eine erfolgreiche Zukunft begleitet.

Aufgaben

  • Beratung von Milchviehbetrieben zu betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Erstellung von individuellen Konzepten zur Neuausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung von Milchviehbetrieben.
  • Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Hofübergaben und Nachfolgeregelungen.
  • Durchführung von Marktanalysen und Erstellung professioneller Gutachten zur Verbesserung der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit.
  • Beratung beim Einstieg in die Direktvermarktung und bei der Planung neuer Stallbauten.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Agrarwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung von landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben, idealerweise im Bereich Milchviehhaltung.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in betriebswirtschaftlichen Analysen und Gutachtenerstellung.
  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Bereitschaf

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Als Sales Development Representative bist du der Erstkontakt für unsere potenziellen Neukunden und legst damit den Grundstein für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit. In dieser Vertriebsrolle entscheidet deine Einschätzung bezüglich des Potentials eines Interessenten maßgeblich über den Teamerfolg.

  • Prospecting: Gezielte Suche nach potenziellen Kunden und Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Qualifizierung: Kontaktaufnahme mit Leads und Bewertung ihrer Bedürfnisse, um sie als qualifizierte Verkaufsmöglichkeiten einzustufen.

  • Erstkontakt: Durchführung von Kaltanrufen und Versenden von Kalt-E-Mails, um Cosuno vorzustellen und Interesse zu wecken.

  • Aufbau von Beziehungen: Knüpfen und Pflegen von Kontakten zu potenziellen Kunden, um langfristiges Vertrauen aufzubauen.

  • Terminvereinbarung: Vereinbarung von Meetings oder Demos für die Account Executives und das Vertriebsteam.

  • Verwaltung der Pipeline: Dokumentation und Pflege der interessierten Prospects in Salesforce.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen im Bereich Akquise und Verkauf, optimalerweise im B2B Sales

  • Du zeigst Zielstrebigkeit und den Ehrgeizig, um selbst für deinen persönlichen Erfolg verantwortlich zu sein

  • Du hast eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Überzeugungskraft, sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich

  • Du bringst gerne deine eigenen Ideen ein, um dich und dein Team auf das nächste Level zu bringen

  • Du hast den Wunsch, eine Karriere im Vertrieb auf- bzw. auszubauen

title: 【 正社員 医療AI事業 】プロダクト開発エンジニア
(Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d) - Remote
Penetration Tester (m/w/d) - Remote
Java Backend Entwickler - Spring Boot & Camunda (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams, mit voller Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

  • Konzeption, Entwicklung und Test von Microservices im Java-Umfeld
  • API-Entwicklung: REST und SOAP, synchron und asynchron, Spezifikation mit OpenAPI 3
  • Prozessautomatisierung mit Camunda BPM
  • Testautomatisierung mit JUnit 5 und Cucumber
  • Betrieb der eigenen Services: Deployment, Monitoring, Fehleranalyse
  • Architektur mitgestalten, nicht nur umsetzen
  • Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor
  • Abstimmung mit Schnittstellenpartnern über Teamgrenzen hinweg

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist das aber keiner. Beim Kunden vor Ort bist du nur für einzelne Termine alle paar Wochen.

Ehrlich vorab: Rufbereitschaft gehört dazu

In einem Teil dieser Projekte betreust du die Services, die du entwickelst, auch im Betrieb — inklusive turnusmäßiger Rufbereitschaft. Das ist geregelt und wird im Team geteilt.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt und deiner Erfahrung:

  • Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel (eisenbahnspezifische Domänen: Fahrplanmanagement, Vertrieb, Leit- und Sicherungstechnik)
  • Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) – regulierte Umgebungen, Barrierefreiheit, Security by Design
  • Ente

title: AI Automation Engineer (Forward-Deployed)
description:
AI Automation Engineer (Forward-Deployed) Surya Narayana Indonesia
About the role
We're an early-stage team that rebuilds businesses' most time-consuming workflows around AI, and keeps them running reliably in production. We work directly inside our clients' operations, finding the workflow that costs them the most coordination and rebuilding it to be faster, cheaper, and more dependable.
You'd be the person who builds those workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership: you take a workflow we've selected with a client, work alongside the team to map how it actually runs, and build the automation that replaces the manual coordination — with proper logging, testing, review steps, and rollback built in from the start, not bolted on after.
It's a forward-deployable role, meaning you're close to the actual work and the actual client, not building in isolation. If you like seeing what you build get used in the real world and matter to a real business, this is that.
What you'd do
Build AI-powered automation for real client workflows — agent orchestration, API integrations, connecting the systems a business already runs on.
Work with the team to map how a workflow actually operates: the steps, the data it touches, the judgment involved, and a clear baseline to measure improvement against.
Build reliability in from the start — testing, logging, human-review checkpoints, and safe rollback — so what you ship can be trusted in live operations.
Prove each workflow in a shadow run alongside the existing process before it goes live, and refine it based on what the run surfaces.
Document what you build to a standard where someone else could operate and maintain it .
Monitor live workflows, catch problems before they surface as client complaints, and improve them over time.
What we're looking for
Solid, self-directed engineering ability — you can own a build end to end without needing close supervision, and you make sound calls on your own.
Genuine care for reliability and maintainability. You're the kind of engineer who documents as they go, builds things others can pick up, and doesn't cut corners that hide until later.
Familiarity with automation and agent tooling — workflow platforms, agent/LLM frameworks, retrieval over documents, plus solid Python and Git — is welcome. We care more about how you reason about building something reliable than which specific tools you've used.
Working understanding of how to make AI/LLM-based automation behave predictably: testing outputs, handling failure, knowing when a human needs to stay in the loop.
Willingness to be close to the client and the real operation — comfortable being embedded in how a business actually works, not just heads-down in code.
Nice to have
Experience taking automation into production and keeping it running

palmerhargreaves ist die Agentur für komplexe Themen und Transformationsaufgaben. Wie keine andere Agentur nutzt palmerhargreaves schon heute alle Möglichkeiten der generativen KI, um die Kommunikation ihrer Kunden noch effizienter und effektiver zu machen. Die Agentur beschäftigt über 100 Mitarbeitende aus 12 Nationen. Zu den Kunden zählen weltbekannte Marken wie Audi, Bayer, Deutsche Telekom, Ford, Henkel und SAP.

Aufgaben

Wenn jemand ChatGPT, Perplexity oder Google AI Overviews nach einer Marke fragt, entscheidet sich in der Antwort, ob diese Marke überhaupt vorkommt – und ob das, was dort über sie steht, stimmt. Wir analysieren das für Konzerne: über fünf KI-Systeme, hunderte Fragen, mehrere Messwellen im Jahr. Aus diesen Rohdaten werden Zahlen, auf die wir Empfehlungen und unsere Kunden Entscheidungen stützen.

Genau da setzt deine Rolle an. Du unterstützt bei Bau und Betreuung der Datenschicht darunter: einlesen, validieren, anreichern, auswertbar machen.

  • Du entwickelst Skripte, die Rohdaten aus unseren GEO-Messungen einlesen, normalisieren und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen (JavaScript/Node.js, Python)
  • Du bindest APIs an – Suchdaten, KI-Systeme, externe Daten, interne Tools, MCP – inklusive Fehlerbehandlung und Rate Limits
  • Du arbeitest in unserem Google-Cloud-Stack: BigQuery für die Datenhaltung, Looker Studio für die Dashboards, Cloud Functions für alles, was automatisch laufen soll
  • Du automatisierst Qualitätsprüfungen. Die Leitfrage dahinter: Fällt ein inkonsistenter Messlauf auf, bevor er im Kundenreport landet?

Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.

The fastest growing part of our business is Herman, our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. description:
brandmediale ist eine inhabergeführte Digitalagentur aus Erfurt. Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln und betreuen wir Websites, Markenauftritte und digitale Kommunikation für mittelständische Unternehmen — vor allem aus Industrie, Energie und B2B. Wir sind ein kleines, erfahrenes Team mit kurzen Wegen. Bei uns gibt es keine Abteilungen, keine Zwischenebenen und keine Projekte, bei denen man nur ein Rädchen ist. Thành thạo Python - ngôn ngữ chính cho toàn bộ AI pipeline.

Hiểu và có kinh nghiệm thực tế với Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Biết làm việc với Vector Database (Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector... là lợi thế).
Có kinh nghiệm từ 1 - 3 năm trong phát triển phần mềm hoặc AI/ML.
Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Git.
Ham học hỏi, chủ động research và thoải mái với môi trường sản phẩm đang phát triển.
Kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt, có thể phối hợp với các team non-tech và technical.
Nice to have: Kinh nghiệm với Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex; hiểu biết về NoSQL (MongoDB, Elasticsearch);

Mức lương: Thỏa thuận theo năng lực.
Tham gia đầy đủ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo quy định.

title: Payment and Treasury Analyst
description:
💰 £50,000 to £80,000 based on London - other locations may vary

📍 London or Remote

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Money moves through Fanvue in three directions every day: fans paying in, acquirers settling to our banks, and creators being paid out what they have earned. At our scale, across a multi-acquirer stack and multiple currencies, proving that all of it happened correctly is a discipline in its own right. That is what this role owns.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Payments & Treasury Analyst to own continuous reconciliation of money movement across the platform, reporting directly to our VP Finance with a dotted line into Operations.

This is a Finance controls role. Operations runs the payment rails. You prove the money moved, every day, independently. The distinction matters and it is the whole point of the job.

Today reconciliation happens periodically. Your job is to make it constant and owned. We are building the ledger and matching tooling in parallel, so the mechanical matching will be automated. What automation cannot do is own the exceptions daily and apply payments judgement: reading an acquirer statement and spotting a fee that does not match the agreement, or knowing whether a settlement gap is a weekend cycle or a genuine break.

Über uns
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann - und machen daraus Süßes, dass einfach richtig gut schmeckt.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Dazu kommen Nachrichten, für die man sich Zeit nehmen muss — seitenlang, und erstaunlich oft steht darin das Wort „lebensverändernd". Menschen, die ihren Zuckerkonsum umgestellt haben und uns erzählen, was sich dadurch für sie verändert hat.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Wer sich für weniger Zucker entscheidet, entscheidet sich nicht einmal — sondern jeden Tag neu. Wir wollen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf diesem Weg begleiten: mit E-Mails und Nachrichten, die zum richtigen Zeitpunkt kommen, die weiterhelfen statt nur zu verkaufen, und die aus einer guten Entscheidung eine Gewohnheit machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Du machst aus Erstkäufern Stammkunden. Du verantwortest unser CRM — Flows, Kampagnen, Segmentierung — baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal von Grund auf auf und entwickelst unser Treue- und Referral-Programm. Deine Nordstern-Metrik: die Wiederkaufrate.

Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein CRM-Team, keine Agentur und keine gewachsene Struktur. Klaviyo läuft, erste Flows stehen — der Rest ist offen. Du bist die erste Person, die diesen Bereich verantwortet und ihn von hier aus aufbaut.

title: Junior Sales Manager DACH (Remote in Germany)
description:
Hi, we're AMBOSS and we're looking for a Junior Sales Manager to help bring Novaheal to nursing schools across Germany.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Novaheal is our learning platform for nursing students and nursing professionals — the same idea behind AMBOSS, built for a group that has been underserved by good digital tools for far too long. You'll own the full sales cycle with nursing schools: finding them, talking to them, running the demo, and signing them. You'll also join a team of nurses, so the people around you know the classrooms and wards you're selling into and can tell you straight away whether a pitch rings true. Because the team is small, you won't be handed a narrow slice of the funnel; you'll see a deal from first email to signature and learn what actually moves the needle. Every school that switches to Novaheal means hundreds of nursing students learning with better material, which is exactly the kind of impact we're here for.</

Job description for AI Model Engineer at Alpha Red Pro Sdn Bhd
Job Highlights
Build the next generation of Enterprise AI capabilities.
Work with cutting-edge open-source AI technologies.
Develop and fine-tune AI models instead of simply consuming AI APIs.
Build AI infrastructure that powers multiple enterprise products.
Grow your career in one of the fastest evolving technology fields.
Job Description
We are looking for a passionate AI Model Engineer to join our growing AI Engineering team. Unlike many organisations that simply integrate third-party AI services, Alpha Red Pro is investing in building our own AI platform and proprietary AI capabilities. Our vision is to develop, fine-tune, evaluate and deploy AI models that become reusable building blocks across multiple enterprise solutions in the Travel, Financial Services and Enterprise domains.
This role focuses on building the AI models and infrastructure that power our products. Rather than primarily consuming cloud-hosted AI APIs, you will be responsible for developing internal AI capabilities that can be adopted by software engineering teams throughout the organisation. If you enjoy experimenting with open-source models, understanding how they work, improving their performance and pushing the boundaries of enterprise AI, we would love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Deploy and manage open-source Large Language Models (LLMs).
Evaluate, benchmark and compare AI models for different business use cases.
Fine-tune domain-specific AI models using company datasets.
Optimise model inference for performance, scalability and cost.
Develop reusable AI services and model APIs for internal engineering teams.
Design model evaluation and benchmarking pipelines.
Research emerging AI technologies and recommend practical adoption.
Collaborate with software engineers to integrate internally hosted AI models into enterprise applications.
Continuously improve AI model quality through experimentation and iterative development.
Document AI architectures, experiments and technical findings.
Job Requirements

  • Du arbeitest eng an der Schnittstelle zwischen Softwareentwicklung und Infrastruktur und bringst ein solides Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur und -entwicklung in die Plattformarbeit ein.
  • Du automatisierst Infrastrukturprozesse konsequent und trägst aktiv dazu bei, manuelle Aufwände zu reduzieren und den Betrieb langfristig wartbar zu gestalten.
  • Du sorgst für ein belastbares Monitoring und Alerting, sodass Probleme frühzeitig sichtbar werden
  • Du übernimmst eine aktive Rolle im Incident Management, analysierst Vorfälle strukturiert, behebst Ursachen nachhaltig und sorgst dafür, dass gewonnene Erkenntnisse direkt in die Weiterentwicklung der Plattform einfließen.
  • Du bist im Rahmen unserer regulären Arbeitszeiten als Ansprechperson erreichbar und stellst damit sicher, dass kritische Vorfälle schnell und zuverlässig adressiert werden.


Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb von Cloud-nativen Plattformen und Infrastrukturen 
  • Tiefgreifendes Know-how in Kubernetes - von der Konzeption über den Aufbau bis zum produktiven Betrieb komplexer Cluster-U

Job description for AI Analytics Engineer at Entobel
YOUR MISSION:
Be the analytical engineer behind factory operations: turn rearing, processing, and quality data into decisions that improve yield, reduce losses, and scale production. You’ll sit at the intersection of the factory floor and the data team. Close enough to understand what happens when a rearing batch underperforms, technical enough to build the systems that catch it early.
KEY ACTIVITIES:
Power BI: Maintain and expand 12 reporting domains (Production, Finance, Sales, R&D...) driving monthly management reviews.
DBT: Write and test transformation models across our 5-layer warehouse (sources to normalization to Datamart); pipelines run hourly via Prefect.
SFM Integration: Pull structured data from our Shopfloor Management app into the analytics layer; help close gaps between records and reality.
Odoo / ERP: Support data extraction and reporting from the Odoo ERP rollout (accounting, inventory, intercompany flows) as it ramps up alongside legacy systems.
Operational KPIs: Monitor production yield, insect meal output, FCR, and survival rates. When a batch underperforms, dig into root causes and recommend process changes.
AI-Assisted Analysis: Leverage LLMs and Python to accelerate insight generation, automate reporting, and reduce manual data wrangling.
WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
2-3 years in data analytics or data engineering (Bachelor degree).
SQL & Power BI: Autonomous proficiency, no handholding .
DBT: Hands-on experience preferred; fast learners considered.
Python: Comfortable with automation, scripting, and analytical workflows.
Mindset: Curious about insect rearing operations. Willing to spend time on the factory floor understanding processes firsthand.
Language: Native Vietnamese; functional English (international team, English documentation).

You don't start from zero. You usually get a real starting point, often a golden data set from the department of a German Mittelstand company: real cases, each with the result an experienced expert would deliver. Your job is to build a system that reaches that result reliably, to bring it into people's working day through an interface they can actually use, and to be able to prove that it works.

Tasks

You typically work on two to three customer projects in parallel.

80% Building: The core of the role

  • Derive a defensible definition of "correct" from reference data, and build an eval that measures it
  • Design and build the AI system itself: model and provider choice, context and prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, agent/workflow logic, retrieval where it earns its place — and deterministic logic where an LLM isn't needed.
  • Do error analysis and iterate deliberately instead of guessing — and demonstrate the improvement
  • Build guardrails, escalation paths and monitoring, so the system doesn't fail loudly and confidently
  • Build the production interface that goes with it: review screens, approvals, human-in-the-loop — in Next.js and TypeScript, not a throwaway prototype
  • Roll the solution out and keep it running + improve it as AI advances

title: New Patient Nurse
description:
If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives.

This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey.

It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life.

What is the Role?

This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants.

This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient.

title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) - Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

title: Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

title: Data Intelligence Analyst
description:
Data Intelligence Analyst PT Tricada Intronik
Responsibilities
Empower VP-level decision-making by delivering rapid, structured analytical intelligence across cross-functional domains, including Business Operations, Product Strategy, and Corporate Functions.
Transform fragmented, multi-source inputs; encompassing internal systems, telemetry logs, and external benchmarks, into high-fidelity, analysis-ready datasets.
Execute rigorous data normalization, reconciliation, and deduplication to engineer reusable "Analysis Views" anchored to standardized enterprise KPI definitions.
Author high-impact intelligence outputs designed for executive consumption, including:
Executive Dashboards: Real-time visibility into mission-critical performance drivers.
Strategic Briefs: Concise narratives identifying variance drivers, downstream implications, and prioritized tactical recommendations.
Provide rapid-response analytical support for cornerstone leadership objectives, including:
Monitoring customer lifecycle velocity and product penetration signals.
Analyzing incident patterns, capacity distribution, and early-warning trend detection.
Quantifying productivity benchmarks and strategic program performance.
Institutionalize analytical speed by maintaining a library of standardized executive templates, KPI taxonomies, and governed dataset structures for recurring strategic inquiries.
Collaborate with General Management across Engineering, Product, and Architecture to harmonize data interpretations, validate assumptions, and ensure a "single source of truth."
Uphold the highest standards of discretion and data integrity while managing sensitive, high-stakes corporate information.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Information Systems / Statistics / Engineering (or equivalent experience).
2+ years of experience in analytics / BI / data analysis roles, with strong execution discipline and stakeholder maturity.
Strong analytical foundations: KPI reasoning, trend analysis, segmentation logic, cohorts/funnels (where applicable), and ability to interpret results for business decisions.
Strong data preparation capability by comfortable handling messy data, joining across sources, and ensuring consistency before analysis.
Strong SQL capability and comfortable with at least one analytics tooling approach (BI platform and/or Python for analysis automation).
Ability to work in fast-moving environments: shifting priorities, short deadlines, and iterative problem statements.
Strong communication by can deliver concise, decision-grade summaries, not only charts.
Nice To Have:
Extensive exposure to multi-domain intelligence, providing strategic insights across Operations, Delivery, Customer Growth, Human Capital/People Analytics, and Efficiency.
Proven ability to institutionalize efficiency by automating complex analytical workflows, utilizing scripting and low-latency pipeline orchestration to ensure seamless, scheduled intelligence refreshes.

Hiring process
Apply through the Sonigo website. The form takes around 10 minutes.

Kami sedang mencari individu berbakat yang ingin bergabung dengan tim kami di beberapa area lokasi kam9 (Kalimantan, Sulawesi, dan Maluku). title: Kundenservice & Community Manager:in (m/w/d) - Teilzeit, Werkstudent:in oder Minijob · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Und auffällig oft geht es in diesen Bewertungen gar nicht ums Produkt, sondern um den Service. Dazu kommen die Nachrichten — seitenlang, mit Fragen zur Umstellung, mit Erfolgsgeschichten, manchmal mit Ärger über ein Paket, das zu spät kam.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Jede dieser Nachrichten ist ein Moment, in dem wir jemanden für gesunden Genuss begeistern können — auch die, die mit Ärger anfängt. Wir wollen, dass am Ende jedes Gesprächs ein erledigtes Anliegen steht und ein Mensch, der gern wiederkommt — nicht eine höfliche Antwort ohne Lösung. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme von NaschNatur gegenüber unseren Kundinnen und unserer Community. Du beantwortest Anfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media, betreust unsere Brand-Kanäle und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen erledigt wird — zugunsten der Kundin, nicht nur beantwortet. Deine Nordstern-Metriken: Lösungszeit und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Ausgangslage

Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein Kundenservice-Team. Der Service hängt aktuell an einer Person, die ihn neben Auftragsbearbeitung und Verwaltung mitmacht.

Das heißt für dich: Du wirst eingearbeitet, aber du bist nach wenigen Wochen die Person, die den Posteingang verantwortet. Und du verantwortest mehr als das Beantworten - du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, unser internes Wiki und das Help Center. Wer eine Frage zum fünften Mal beantwortet, ohne sich zu fragen warum, ist in dieser Rolle falsch.

title: Solution Architect (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.

Prodia Occupational Health Center (Prodia OHC) merupakan klinik kedokteran okupasi pertama di Indonesia. Prodia OHC pertama kali didirikan di Jakarta, terletak di kawasan bisnis ‘segitiga emas’ Jakarta dengan akses yang mudah dicapai. Klinik ini didisain secara khusus untuk melayani klien korporat dengan cakupan layanan kesehatan seperti pemeriksaan kesehatan karyawan dan calon karyawan, konsultasi dokter, layanan dental care, vaksinasi, laboratorium klinik, dan lain-lain. Klinik Prodia OHC didukung oleh para tenaga ahli di bidang kedokteran okupasi, serta paramedik yang terlatih dan tersertifikasi.
Klinik Prodia OHC juga dilengkapi peralatan medis yang sesuai untuk layanan pemeriksaan kesehatan kerja. Layanan pemeriksaan kesehatan kerja yang dilakukan berbasis pada kedokteran okupasii dengan memperhatikan jenis pekerjaan, kondisi lingkungan kerja, dan bahaya potensial yang dialami pekerja.
Layanan kesehatan kerja Prodia OHC dilakukan secara ‘one stop service’ serta bersifat holistik, komprehensif, dan ‘customized’ terhadap kebutuhan perusahaan dan karyawan, yaitu memperhatikan dan menyesuaikan dengan jenis pekerjaan, lingkungan kerja, serta risiko bahaya potensial yang dialami pekerja.
Di awal tahun 2014, Prodia OHC hadir di kawasan industri Cikarang. Dengan hadirnya Prodia OHC ini diharapkan para pelaku industri semakin dekat dalam pemenuhan kebutuhan kesehatan kerja di tempatnya.

Job Description:
1. Membuat Laporan Identifikasi & Analisa Problem Farming Weekly
a. Mengumpulkan data harian dari tim lapangan (greenhouse/kebun) terkait kondisi tanaman, hama/penyakit, dan kendala operasional
b. Melakukan rekap dan tabulasi data mingguan ke dalam format standar (excel/dashboard)
c. Melakukan analisa akar masalah (root cause analysis) dari isu yang ditemukan
d. Berkoordinasi dengan tim agronomis/PIC lapangan untuk validasi temuan
2. Membuat Planning Tanam GH (Benih)
a. Menyesuaikan planning dengan permintaan/demand pasar (forecast penjualan)
b. Membuat kalender tanam (planting schedule) per varietas dan per GH
c. Berkoordinasi dengan tim procurement terkait stok dan pengadaan benih
d. Melakukan update planning jika terjadi perubahan kondisi lapangan (gagal tanam, reschedule, dsb)
3. Membuat Estimasi Panen Bulanan
a. Menganalisa data pertumbuhan tanaman (usia tanam, fase pertumbuhan) untuk prediksi waktu panen
b. Menghitung proyeksi kuantitas panen berdasarkan luas tanam, varietas, dan performa historis
c. Menyesuaikan estimasi dengan faktor eksternal (cuaca, hama, kondisi tanaman terkini)
d. Menyusun laporan estimasi panen bulanan per komoditas/per GH
4. Manage SDM Kegiatan Pengambilan Data Gramasi
a. Menyusun jadwal/rooster petugas pengambil data gramasi (harian/mingguan)
b. Melakukan spot check/validasi kualitas data yang diambil (akurasi timbang, konsistensi metode)
c. Memastikan data gramasi terkumpul tepat waktu untuk diproses ke sistem/laporan

4. Bersedia bekerja dengan mobilitas tinggi (lapangan & indoor/office)
5. Mahir mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (pivot table, VLOOKUP, formula, dashboard sederhana)
6. Memahami dasar analisa data & statistik (rata-rata, tren, proyeksi/forecasting)
7. Familiar dengan Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Forms untuk pengumpulan data lapangan)

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Personalbesetzung unserer größeren You and Mee Events – von unseren regelmäßigen Formaten bis zu Highlights wie Halloween und Silvester.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Marketing und Product zusammen, entwickelst gemeinsame Business- und Go-to-Market-Strategien und trägst zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung von Pipeline und Umsatz bei. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. We're hiring a Pooled Creator Success Manager to own retention and revenue outcomes across a portfolio of 500+ creators in a 1:many, tech-touch model.

Think CS operations meets account management.

You will report to Thea and work closely with the wider Creator Success team.

  • Own a pooled book of 500+ creators with full accountability for gross revenue retention

Monitor data quality and laboratory performance metrics through automation, dashboards, and reporting tools.
Conduct statistical and computational analyses using internal and public biological datasets.
Generate data visualizations, reports, and insights to support scientific, clinical, and business decision-making.
Collaborate with laboratory, product, technology, and cross-functional teams to translate biological data into actionable outcomes.
Support research projects, validation studies, and the development of new genomic products and services.
Participate in quality assurance activities, including validation of analytical workflows and result review.
Maintain clear documentation of analytical methods, pipelines, databases, and standard operating procedures.
Stay up to date with advances in bioinformatics, genomics, and data science, and contribute to continuous process improvement.

Support mock runs & cutover and clear data defects under the Data Migration Lead

You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level Japanese speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to Japanese.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.</

title: Knit - Research Manager
description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition

Virale Short-Form-Videos analysieren, verstehen warum sie funktioniert haben, und das für unsere Creator adaptieren.

Jeden Post analysieren: warum hat das eingeschlagen, warum ist das gefloppt, worauf setzen wir diese Woche.

Besessenheit von Short-Form. Du schaust täglich stundenlang freiwillig TikTok und Reels und kannst erklären, warum ein Video funktioniert. Du lernst das nicht erst, du lebst es schon.

Job description for AI Agent Engineer at bTaskee Vietnam
Role Overview:
We are looking for a
Middle/Senior AI Agent Engineer
to design, build, and harden autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that operate within bTaskee's product ecosystem (customer chat support, Tasker assistance tools, internal operations automation, and more). A core focus of this role is harness engineering – building the evaluation, testing, and orchestration infrastructure that let us safely develop, test, and continuously improve agent behavior before and after it reaches production.
You'll work closely with product, backend, and data teams to turn LLM capabilities into reliable, measurable, and maintainable agent systems – not just prompts that work once in a demo.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain multi-agent systems and autonomous AI Agents
(tool-use, multi-step reasoning, memory/state management) for customer-facing and internal bTaskee products.
Build and maintain agent harnesses
: test environments, simulated user/task scenarios, scoring rubrics, and regression suites that evaluate agent behavior across many conditions before deployment.
Define and track evaluation metrics
(task success rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost per interaction, tool-call accuracy) and build dashboards/pipelines to monitor them continuously.
Integrate agents
with internal APIs, databases, and third-party tools (search, payments, scheduling, notifications) via structured tool-calling.
Own the full agent lifecycle
: prompt/context design, tool orchestration, guardrails, fallback logic, and production monitoring.

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

What you'll do

Als Senior Oracle Data Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Datenbanklösungen und gestaltest performante, sichere Anwendungen auf Basis von Oracle-Technologien.
